description: Get the FULL TEXT of a section of the Alaska Statutes (Alaska Code) by citation. "4.11.010" (AS 04.11.010) is alcohol-license requirements; "11.41.100" (AS 11.41.100) is murder in the first degree. Accepts natural forms: "4.11.010", "AS 04.11.010", "Alaska Statutes 11.41.100". Returns the current statutory text, the official catchline, and title/chapter context. Alaska publishes the CURRENT text only through this endpoint — no amendment-history line and no historical (pre-amendment) version; this tool says so rather than guessing. Keyless. Use for "what does AS 11.41.100 say" or to check an Alaska statute a case or lease relies on.

citation.description: Section citation, title.chapter.section, e.g. "4.11.010" (alcohol licensing) or "11.41.100" (murder).
